title: BCrypt.Net-Next
description: A robust BCrypt hashing library for secure password storage in .NET.

data.text: `BCrypt.Net-Next` is the de facto BCrypt implementation for .NET. It hashes passwords using the BCrypt algorithm, which is adaptive and can be tuned to remain secure as hardware improves.
Use `BCrypt.HashPassword` to hash a password and `BCrypt.Verify` to compare a password against its hash.

data.title: Hash and Verify
data.content: Hash a password and verify it later.

data.text: Always use a work factor of at least 10. Store only the hash, never the plain password. BCrypt salts each hash automatically, so you do not need to manage salts separately.

terms.definition: Generates a BCrypt hash from a plain text password.
Compares a plain text password to a BCrypt hash safely.
The cost parameter that controls how computationally expensive hashing is.

data.title: Warning
data.text: Never store plain text passwords. Always hash before persisting and verify hashes rather than decrypting them.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: BCrypt is the standard for secure password storage in .NET applications.
